# apple_in_app_purchase_price_schedule (Resource)

Sets an in-app purchase's price: a price point in a base territory, from which App Store Connect sets equivalent prices in the other territories, plus optional manual prices for other territories and scheduled price changes. Find price points with `data.apple_in_app_purchase_price_points`. Every change replaces the whole schedule. App Store Connect can't delete a schedule, so destroying the resource leaves the prices as they are. Import it by the owner's ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_in_app_purchase_price_points" "usd" {
  in_app_purchase_id = apple_in_app_purchase.coins.id
  territories        = ["USA"]
  customer_prices    = ["0.99"]
}

resource "apple_in_app_purchase_price_schedule" "coins" {
  in_app_purchase_id = apple_in_app_purchase.coins.id
  base_territory     = "USA"
  manual_prices = [
    { price_point_id = data.apple_in_app_purchase_price_points.usd.price_points[0].id },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_territory` (String) Territory whose price the others are equalized from, e.g. `USA`.
- `in_app_purchase_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the in-app purchase, e.g. `apple_in_app_purchase.example.id`.
- `manual_prices` (Attributes Set) Manual prices. The base territory needs one; other territories without one get the equivalent of the base price. A territory can have one price without dates, and dated prices schedule changes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manual_prices))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the price schedule.

<a id="nestedatt--manual_prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `manual_prices`

Required:

- `price_point_id` (String) ID of the price point, which sets the territory and price.

Optional:

- `end_date` (String) Last day of the price. Unset means no end.
- `start_date` (String) First day of the price, e.g. `2026-12-01`. Unset means now.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_in_app_purchase_price_schedule.coins
  identity = {
    in_app_purchase_id = "6446452615"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `in_app_purchase_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the in-app purchase, e.g. `apple_in_app_purchase.example.id`.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_in_app_purchase_price_schedule.coins 6446452615
```
